theory_candidates.name: POLICY_SURFACE_EQUIVALENCE_CLASS
theory_candidates.statement: Scientific policy identity may be an equivalence class of representations preserving action partitions and admissible failure/transport boundaries, rather than a unique syntax.

theory_candidates.name: NAMED_MAXIM_AS_REGIONAL_COMPRESSION
theory_candidates.statement: A named design maxim may be a human-legible regional compression of a policy-surface equivalence class.
